payload.title: Document AWS identifiers outside Git (site variables, migration recipe) on p.apyr.us
payload.description: Add to the p.apyr.us hosting docs the content of docs/site-hosting.md section 'AWS identifiers outside Git': the variable table (PAPYRUS_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID, PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_APP_ID, PAPYRUS_COMPUTE_ROLE_ARN, PAPYRUS_EDGE_DISTRIBUTION_ARN, PAPYRUS_PROSPECTUS_ACCOUNTS_API_STAGE_ARN, vars.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID, vars.AMPLIFY_APP_ID), the fail-closed owning-app guard, and the per-site migration recipe.
